name: keyboard-dev-toolkit
description: Design custom mechanical keyboards in your browser — KLE-compatible layout editor that auto-generates the PCB (switch/stabilizer/mounting-hole placement) and mounting plate, exports DXF & STEP for manufacturing, AI design assistant included. Free, open source, fully offline.

paragraphs: All-in-one custom keyboard design tool — draw the layout in your browser, generate the plate and PCB, and export the files you need to build it (core features run locally, advanced geometry & STP assembly are computed in the cloud).
KLE-compatible · core runs locally · advanced features in the cloud · free & open source
Demo: switch the UI language, then ask the AI assistant to design a 60% keyboard — the layout is drawn straight onto the canvas.
features: Draw the layout — drag-and-drop key placement like KLE, with rotated clusters, stepped/homing/decal keys and more
Generate the plate — one-click plate geometry, exported as DXF for CNC / laser cutting
Generate the PCB — automatic switch, stabilizer and mounting-hole placement, producing the design files your PCB manufacturer needs
Export 3D models — production-grade STEP (STP) models of the PCB, the plate and the components on them, ready to import into any 3D software
AI assistant — describe your layout in natural language, and the AI designs it for you (supports DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible APIs)

whatItDoes.text: All-in-one custom keyboard design tool — draw the layout in your browser, generate the plate and PCB, and export the files you need to build it (core features run locally, advanced geometry & STP assembly are computed in the cloud).
